public_problem.summary: GitHub is expanding agentic repository work while adding security validation, policy-constrained agentic workflows, approval boundaries, and platform-level lifecycle/authorization concerns for coding agents.

official_sources.title: Security validation for third-party coding agents
GitHub Agentic Workflows is now in public preview
Bot-created pull requests can run workflows if approved
Staff Software Engineer — Mission Control, job 5611

bottleneck: Agent-generated repository changes need a trustworthy promotion boundary that binds the intended change, current canonical state, required validation, authorized approval, exact mutation bytes, provider result, eventual-state reconciliation, post-action readback, replay behavior, and durable evidence.
reusable_invariant: A repository mutation is complete only when the exact intended bytes were authorized against the expected canonical head, required gates passed, bounded authority executed the mutation once, provider state reconciled to the returned mutation identity, canonical readback confirmed it, replay could not duplicate it, and a terminal receipt preserved the result.
transfer_argument: GlacierEQ independently implemented and reproduced a governed GitHub mutation path that binds exact change identity, expected repository state, required validation, bounded approval, short-lived repository authority, exact provider bytes, provider mutation identity, bounded eventual-state reconciliation, canonical readback, replay suppression, and receipt evidence. The implementation is now the canonical specialist for this admitted GlacierEQ capability lineage. This proof-bound company-specific claim remains transferable engineering evidence for the public GitHub operating problem; it is not GitHub adoption evidence.

current_proof.observed: 26/26 exact Merge Authority tests and 38/38 proof-host gateway tests passed; canonical Apex source was reproduced through a real GitHub provider mutation on disposable branches; canonical readback matched the provider commit; replay returned DUPLICATE_ALREADY_COMPLETED without a second mutation; the short-lived token was revoked; target main remained unchanged. The outward portfolio production projection was then compiled from effective Helix authority and read back through the canonical Vercel alias with V25/V26 verification PASS. Canonical lineage resolution selects EXTEND_CANONICAL for the existing Apex specialist rather than creating a duplicate Merge Authority repository.
current_proof.limitation: The proof is independent GlacierEQ work on disposable proof branches. No GitHub adoption, employment, endorsement, GitHub production deployment, production-scale reliability, latency, throughput, or durability is established. The private implementation source remains private.

next_company_gate: Maintain proof and projection freshness at the proof_bound_company_specific ceiling. Any claim of GitHub adoption, GitHub production deployment, or production-scale reliability requires new public evidence and an additional gate; none is claimed here.
